## RexWise AI Receptionist
Independent voice AI product by Faheem Abbas. Cloud-connected Android gateway, Urdu/English calls, caller capture, saved appointment requests and QR pairing. Real SIM conversations tested on a compatible Pixel. Managed pricing and demos: https://rexwise.com/ai-receptionist/ . Country pricing does not guarantee local-number or device availability.

## Other RexWise products
- [Hostel Manager](https://rexwise.com/hostel-management-software/): room and bed allocation, residents, fees, dues and receipts.
- [GymDesk](https://faheemabbas766.github.io/projects.html#gymdesk): memberships, renewals, front-desk check-ins and branch roles. Demo enquiries through RexWise.
